C0544.title: Woman Detained for Defrauding Refunds Through Repeated Product Switches Over Four Years
C0544.summary: A woman was found to have defrauded refunds totaling over 20,000 yuan by simultaneously returning 121 switched items. Her repeated malicious refund scheme over four years is suspected to constitute fraud, and she has been placed under criminal detention by police.

references.title: Over 4 Years, Swapped and Returned Online Purchases, Including 121 Clothes in One Order, Fraudulently Obtained Refunds of Over 20,000 Yuan
